title: John Norseen at Allagash during 1976 abduction testing subcutaneous tracking device

tellings.quote: He said he was doing a TTR, tag, trace, retrieve exercise with a subcutaneous device that they were testing

plain: An unnamed witness to a 1976 abduction at Allagash, Maine, says that a man named John Norseen later told him he had been there at the time. According to the witness, Norseen said he was running a "tag, trace, retrieve" exercise with a tracking device placed under the skin that was being tested. If true, it would mean people, not only something unknown, were involved in the event.
